name: ispstats_stream
pixel_format: unsigned 8/10-bit; CH=1 gray or CH=3 packed {R,G,B} MSB-first
zone_grid: runtime zones_x x zones_y in [1,8] each, zones_x<=img_w, zones_y<=img_h; zx=floor(x*zones_x/img_w) via single-carry Bresenham
statistics: per-zone {count, sum0, sum1, sum2, oe, focus}; oe = any-channel >= thresh; focus = causal first-difference gradient L1 on luma (r+2g+b)>>2, borders contribute 0
result_interface: independent ping-pong record RAM readout: res_new pulse 1 cycle after last pixel, res_done/res_frame/res_count per bank, res_bank/res_addr -> res_data with 1-cycle sync-read latency, no flow control
configuration: atomic cfg_valid/cfg_ready between frames; illegal fields rejected with cfg_error
throughput: input II=1 sustained any legal config; result pushes <=1/cycle; no drain phase; back-to-back frames allowed
remaining: statistics and offline analysis only; no closed-loop AE/AWB/AF acceptance without camera-interface evidence
focus operator is causal first-difference, not 3x3 Sobel
empty zones (grid finer than image) rejected as illegal config
record set readable for one following frame; not flow-controlled
routed timing and board qualification pending
